title: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to write arbitrary files due…
description: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data version 5.4.0.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the system. This vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or availability but can lead to integrity compromise by unauthorized file modification.
